                    <span class="key-card-num">04</span>
                    <h3>Policy & Energy Mix Determine Outcomes</h3>
                    <p>France vs. Germany shows that prosperity does not require high emissions. Nuclear, renewables, and active policy can decouple growth from carbon output.</p>
                </div>

                <div class="closing-note reveal">
                    <strong>For negotiators:</strong> Total emissions, per capita allocations, and historical cumulative responsibility each tell a different story — and each matters differently across the development spectrum. Tracking all three simultaneously is essential for equitable climate policy.
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <script>
        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           Handles navigation, animations, progress
           ========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
                this.currentIndex = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupBarAnimations();
            }

            /* --- IntersectionObserver adds .visible for CSS animations --- */
            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            // Find slide index for progress tracking
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentIndex = idx;
                                this.updateProgress();
                                this.updateNavDots();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            /* --- Animate bar charts when slide becomes visible --- */
            setupBarAnimations() {
                // Standard bars use CSS custom property --w for width
                const applyBarWidths = (slide) => {
                    slide.querySelectorAll('.bar-fill[style*="--w"]').forEach(bar => {
                        const w = bar.style.getPropertyValue('--w') || bar.getAttribute('style').match(/--w:\s*([\d.%]+)/)?.[1];
                        if (w) bar.style.width = w;
                    });
                    // Per capita bars use --pw
                    slide.querySelectorAll('.pc-fill[style*="--pw"]').forEach(bar => {
                        const w = bar.style.getPropertyValue('--pw') || bar.getAttribute('style').match(/--pw:\s*([\d.%]+)/)?.[1];
                        if (w) bar.style.width = w;
                    });
                };

                // Observe slides for bar animation
                const barObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            setTimeout(() => applyBarWidths(entry.target), 200);
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.4 });

                this.slides.forEach(s => barObserver.observe(s));
            }

            /* --- Keyboard navigation: arrows, space, page keys --- */
            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch(e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex + 1);
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex - 1);
                            break;
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex + 1);
                            break;
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex - 1);
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.totalSlides - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            /* --- Mouse wheel: debounced to prevent multiple slides per scroll --- */
            setupWheelNav() {
                let wheelTimeout = null;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    if (this.isScrolling) return;
                    clearTimeout(wheelTimeout);
                    wheelTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                        if (e.deltaY > 0) {
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex + 1);
                        } else {
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex - 1);
                        }
                    }, 50);
                }, { passive: false });
            }

            /* --- Touch / swipe support --- */
            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                let touchStartX = 0;

                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                    touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const dy = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    const dx = touchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > 40) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex + (dy > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            /* --- Navigate to slide index with scroll-into-view --- */
            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.totalSlides || this.isScrolling) return;
                this.isScrolling = true;
                this.currentIndex = index;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                setTimeout(() => { this.isScrolling = false; }, 800);
                this.updateProgress();
                this.updateNavDots();
            }

            /* --- Progress bar across top of viewport --- */
            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgress();
            }

            updateProgress() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const pct = ((this.currentIndex) / (this.totalSlides - 1)) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            /* --- Navigation dot indicators on right edge --- */
            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                if (!nav) return;
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    nav.appendChild(dot);
                });
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot').forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentIndex);
                });
            }
        }

        // Initialise on DOM ready
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();

            // Mark first slide visible immediately
            const firstSlide = document.querySelector('.slide');
            if (firstSlide) firstSlide.classList.add('visible');
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        /* Comparison bar visual */
        .ppm-bar-wrap {

        .ppm-bar-fill.current { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), var(--accent)); width: 0; }

           SLIDE 3: GLOBAL EMISSIONS TRAJECTORY
           ========================================== */
        .trajectory-layout {

            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);

        }

        /* SVG line chart for emissions trajectory */
        .chart-container {
            background: var(--bg-card);

            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);

            display: flex;

        .chart-title {

        .trajectory-milestones {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }

        .milestone-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);

        .milestone-val {

            font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2.5vw, 1.8rem);

            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .milestone-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE 4: TOP EMITTERS
           ========================================== */
        .emitters-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-top: calc(var(--slide-padding) + 2.5rem);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            align-items: start;
        }

        .emitters-left {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }

        .section-heading {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.15;
        }

        .section-subheading {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* Horizontal bar chart */
        .bar-chart {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.35rem, 1vh, 0.65rem);
        }

        .bar-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 0.875rem);
        }

        .bar-country {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            min-width: clamp(4.5rem, 8vw, 7rem);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .bar-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(10px, 1.8vh, 18px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            border-radius: 3px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 3px;
            width: 0;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .bar-fill { /* Widths applied via inline style */ }

        .bar-fill.china   { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f97316, #ef4444); }
        .bar-fill.usa     { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3b82f6, #6366f1); }
        .bar-fill.india   { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #eab308, #f97316); }
        .bar-fill.eu      { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-blue)); }
        .bar-fill.germany { background: rgba(139, 154, 184, 0.5); }
        .bar-fill.brazil  { background: rgba(139, 154, 184, 0.4); }
        .bar-fill.uk      { background: rgba(139, 154, 184, 0.35); }
        .bar-fill.france  { background: rgba(139, 154, 184, 0.3); }

        .bar-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            min-width: 4rem;
        }

        .emitters-right {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .figure-wrap {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            overflow: hidden;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .figure-wrap img {
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            max-height: min(40vh, 320px);
            object-fit: cover;
            display: block;
        }

        .figure-caption {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.85vw, 0.72rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE 5: REGIONAL SHARE SHIFT
           ========================================== */
        .regional-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.25rem);
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-top: calc(var(--slide-padding) + 2.5rem);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .regional-body {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            align-items: center;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .era-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.875rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }

        .era-year {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .era-year.current { color: var(--accent); }

        /* Stacked area visual using CSS */
        .region-stack {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 3px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .region-band {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            padding: clamp(4px, 1vh, 8px) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            gap: 0.75rem;
        }

        .region-band-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
            min-width: 6rem;
        }

        .region-band-pct {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
            margin-left: auto;
        }

        .band-eu-us-1900 { background: #3b5998; }
        .band-asia-1900 { background: #1e3a5f; }
        .band-other-1900 { background: #0f2340; }

        .band-asia-2024 { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f97316, #ef4444); }
        .band-eu-us-2024 { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3b82f6, #6366f1); }
        .band-other-2024 { background: rgba(80, 100, 130, 0.8); }

        .shift-arrow {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }

        .shift-arrow-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            color: var(--accent);
            opacity: 0.7;
        }

        .shift-note {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: center;
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE 6: PER CAPITA 150× GAP
           ========================================== */
        .percapita-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-top: calc(var(--slide-padding) + 2.5rem);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            align-items: start;
        }

        .percapita-chart {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .pc-bar-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 0.875rem);
        }

        .pc-country {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            min-width: clamp(3.5rem, 6vw, 6rem);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .pc-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(8px, 1.6vh, 16px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            border-radius: 3px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .pc-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 3px;
            width: 0;
            transition: width 1.1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .pc-fill { /* applied via inline style */ }

        .pc-fill.highest { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ef4444, #f97316); }
        .pc-fill.high    { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f97316, #eab308); }
        .pc-fill.medium  { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #eab308, #84cc16); }
        .pc-fill.average { background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.8); }
        .pc-fill.low     { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-blue)); }
        .pc-fill.lowest  { background: rgba(139, 154, 184, 0.4); }

        .pc-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            min-width: 3rem;
        }

        .percapita-right {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .figure-wrap-sm img {
            max-height: min(32vh, 220px);
        }

        .highlight-box {
            background: var(--accent-dim);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 201, 167, 0.3);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        .highlight-box p {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .highlight-box strong {
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE 7: 2024 ANNUAL CHANGE MAP
           ========================================== */
        .map-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.25rem);
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-top: calc(var(--slide-padding) + 2.5rem);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .map-body {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            overflow: hidden;
            align-items: start;
        }

        .map-figure {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .map-figure img {
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            max-height: min(52vh, 400px);
            object-fit: cover;
            display: block;
        }

        .map-analysis {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }

        .change-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            border-left: 3px solid transparent;
        }

        .change-card.declining { border-left-color: var(--accent); }
        .change-card.rising { border-left-color: var(--accent-orange); }
        .change-card.large-jump { border-left-color: var(--accent-red); }

        .change-card-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
        }

        .change-dot {
            width: clamp(8px, 1.2vw, 12px);
            height: clamp(8px, 1.2vw, 12px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .dot-blue  { background: var(--accent); }
        .dot-orange { background: var(--accent-orange); }
        .dot-red   { background: var(--accent-red); }

        .change-card-title {
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .change-card-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE 8: ENERGY MIX
           ========================================== */
        .energy-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.25rem);
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-top: calc(var(--slide-padding) + 2.5rem);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .energy-body {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 3rem);
            overflow: hidden;
            align-items: start;
        }

        /* Comparison table */
        .compare-table {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .compare-table table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
        }

        .compare-table th {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1.2vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 0.9vw, 0.75rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-align: left;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .compare-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1.2vw, 0.75rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .compare-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

        .compare-table .country-col {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .co2-low  { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; font-family: var(--font-mono); }
        .co2-mid  { color: var(--accent-yellow); font-weight: 700; font-family: var(--font-mono); }
        .co2-high { color: var(--accent-orange); font-weight: 700; font-family: var(--font-mono); }

        .energy-takeaways {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }

        .takeaway-item {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        .takeaway-item h4 {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 0.3em;
        }

        .takeaway-item p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE 9: KEY TAKEAWAYS
           ========================================== */
        .takeaways-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-top: calc(var(--slide-padding) + 2.5rem);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .takeaways-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .key-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.875rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.35rem, 1vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .key-card-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 0.9vw, 0.75rem);
            color: var(--accent);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
        }

        .key-card h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 1.8vw, 1.25rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.25;
        }

        .key-card p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .key-card:nth-child(1) { border-top: 3px solid var(--accent-red); }
        .key-card:nth-child(2) { border-top: 3px solid var(--accent-orange); }
        .key-card:nth-child(3) { border-top: 3px solid var(--accent); }
        .key-card:nth-child(4) { border-top: 3px solid var(--accent-blue); }

        .closing-note {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            background: var(--accent-dim);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 201, 167, 0.25);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .closing-note strong { color: var(--accent); }

    <script>
        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           Handles navigation, animations, progress
           ========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
                this.currentIndex = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupBarAnimations();
            }

            /* --- IntersectionObserver adds .visible for CSS animations --- */
            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            // Find slide index for progress tracking
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentIndex = idx;
                                this.updateProgress();
                                this.updateNavDots();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            /* --- Animate bar charts when slide becomes visible --- */
            setupBarAnimations() {
                // Standard bars use CSS custom property --w for width
                const applyBarWidths = (slide) => {
                    slide.querySelectorAll('.bar-fill[style*="--w"]').forEach(bar => {
                        const w = bar.style.getPropertyValue('--w') || bar.getAttribute('style').match(/--w:\s*([\d.%]+)/)?.[1];
                        if (w) bar.style.width = w;
                    });
                    // Per capita bars use --pw
                    slide.querySelectorAll('.pc-fill[style*="--pw"]').forEach(bar => {
                        const w = bar.style.getPropertyValue('--pw') || bar.getAttribute('style').match(/--pw:\s*([\d.%]+)/)?.[1];
                        if (w) bar.style.width = w;
                    });
                };

                // Observe slides for bar animation
                const barObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            setTimeout(() => applyBarWidths(entry.target), 200);
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.4 });

                this.slides.forEach(s => barObserver.observe(s));
            }

            /* --- Keyboard navigation: arrows, space, page keys --- */
            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch(e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex + 1);
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex - 1);
                            break;
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex + 1);
                            break;
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex - 1);
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.totalSlides - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            /* --- Mouse wheel: debounced to prevent multiple slides per scroll --- */
            setupWheelNav() {
                let wheelTimeout = null;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    if (this.isScrolling) return;
                    clearTimeout(wheelTimeout);
                    wheelTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                        if (e.deltaY > 0) {
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex + 1);
                        } else {
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex - 1);
                        }
                    }, 50);
                }, { passive: false });
            }

            /* --- Touch / swipe support --- */
            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                let touchStartX = 0;

                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                    touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const dy = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    const dx = touchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > 40) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex + (dy > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            /* --- Navigate to slide index with scroll-into-view --- */
            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.totalSlides || this.isScrolling) return;
                this.isScrolling = true;
                this.currentIndex = index;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                setTimeout(() => { this.isScrolling = false; }, 800);
                this.updateProgress();
                this.updateNavDots();
            }

            /* --- Progress bar across top of viewport --- */
            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgress();
            }

            updateProgress() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const pct = ((this.currentIndex) / (this.totalSlides - 1)) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            /* --- Navigation dot indicators on right edge --- */
            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                if (!nav) return;
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    nav.appendChild(dot);
                });
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot').forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentIndex);
                });
            }
        }

        // Initialise on DOM ready
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();

            // Mark first slide visible immediately
            const firstSlide = document.querySelector('.slide');
            if (firstSlide) firstSlide.classList.add('visible');
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE 4: TOP EMITTERS
           ========================================== */
        .emitters-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-top: calc(var(--slide-padding) + 2.5rem);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            align-items: start;
        }

        .emitters-left {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }

        .section-heading {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.15;
        }

        .section-subheading {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* Horizontal bar chart */
        .bar-chart {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.35rem, 1vh, 0.65rem);
        }

        .bar-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 0.875rem);
        }

        .bar-country {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            min-width: clamp(4.5rem, 8vw, 7rem);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .bar-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(10px, 1.8vh, 18px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            border-radius: 3px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 3px;
            width: 0;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .bar-fill { /* Widths applied via inline style */ }

        .bar-fill.china   { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f97316, #ef4444); }
        .bar-fill.usa     { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3b82f6, #6366f1); }
        .bar-fill.india   { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #eab308, #f97316); }
        .bar-fill.eu      { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-blue)); }
        .bar-fill.germany { background: rgba(139, 154, 184, 0.5); }
        .bar-fill.brazil  { background: rgba(139, 154, 184, 0.4); }
        .bar-fill.uk      { background: rgba(139, 154, 184, 0.35); }
        .bar-fill.france  { background: rgba(139, 154, 184, 0.3); }

        .bar-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            min-width: 4rem;
        }

        .emitters-right {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .figure-wrap {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            overflow: hidden;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .figure-wrap img {
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            max-height: min(40vh, 320px);
            object-fit: cover;
            display: block;
        }

        .figure-caption {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.85vw, 0.72rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE 5: REGIONAL SHARE SHIFT
           ========================================== */
        .regional-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.25rem);
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-top: calc(var(--slide-padding) + 2.5rem);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .regional-body {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            align-items: center;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .era-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.875rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }

        .era-year {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .era-year.current { color: var(--accent); }

        /* Stacked area visual using CSS */
        .region-stack {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 3px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .region-band {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            padding: clamp(4px, 1vh, 8px) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            gap: 0.75rem;
        }

        .region-band-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
            min-width: 6rem;
        }

        .region-band-pct {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
            margin-left: auto;
        }

        .band-eu-us-1900 { background: #3b5998; }
        .band-asia-1900 { background: #1e3a5f; }
        .band-other-1900 { background: #0f2340; }

        .band-asia-2024 { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f97316, #ef4444); }
        .band-eu-us-2024 { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3b82f6, #6366f1); }
        .band-other-2024 { background: rgba(80, 100, 130, 0.8); }

        .shift-arrow {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }

        .shift-arrow-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            color: var(--accent);
            opacity: 0.7;
        }

        .shift-note {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: center;
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE 6: PER CAPITA 150× GAP
           ========================================== */
        .percapita-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-top: calc(var(--slide-padding) + 2.5rem);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            align-items: start;
        }

        .percapita-chart {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .pc-bar-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 0.875rem);
        }

        .pc-country {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            min-width: clamp(3.5rem, 6vw, 6rem);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .pc-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(8px, 1.6vh, 16px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            border-radius: 3px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .pc-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 3px;
            width: 0;
            transition: width 1.1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .pc-fill { /* applied via inline style */ }

        .pc-fill.highest { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ef4444, #f97316); }
        .pc-fill.high    { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f97316, #eab308); }
        .pc-fill.medium  { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #eab308, #84cc16); }
        .pc-fill.average { background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.8); }
        .pc-fill.low     { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-blue)); }
        .pc-fill.lowest  { background: rgba(139, 154, 184, 0.4); }

        .pc-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            min-width: 3rem;
        }

        .percapita-right {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .figure-wrap-sm img {
            max-height: min(32vh, 220px);
        }

        .highlight-box {
            background: var(--accent-dim);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 201, 167, 0.3);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        .highlight-box p {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .highlight-box strong {
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE 7: 2024 ANNUAL CHANGE MAP
           ========================================== */
        .map-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.25rem);
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-top: calc(var(--slide-padding) + 2.5rem);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .map-body {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            overflow: hidden;
            align-items: start;
        }

        .map-figure {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .map-figure img {
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            max-height: min(52vh, 400px);
            object-fit: cover;
            display: block;
        }

        .map-analysis {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }

        .change-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            border-left: 3px solid transparent;
        }

        .change-card.declining { border-left-color: var(--accent); }
        .change-card.rising { border-left-color: var(--accent-orange); }
        .change-card.large-jump { border-left-color: var(--accent-red); }

        .change-card-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
        }

        .change-dot {
            width: clamp(8px, 1.2vw, 12px);
            height: clamp(8px, 1.2vw, 12px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .dot-blue  { background: var(--accent); }
        .dot-orange { background: var(--accent-orange); }
        .dot-red   { background: var(--accent-red); }

        .change-card-title {
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .change-card-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE 8: ENERGY MIX
           ========================================== */
        .energy-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.25rem);
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-top: calc(var(--slide-padding) + 2.5rem);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .energy-body {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 3rem);
            overflow: hidden;
            align-items: start;
        }

        /* Comparison table */
        .compare-table {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .compare-table table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
        }

        .compare-table th {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1.2vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 0.9vw, 0.75rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-align: left;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .compare-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1.2vw, 0.75rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .compare-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

        .compare-table .country-col {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .co2-low  { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; font-family: var(--font-mono); }
        .co2-mid  { color: var(--accent-yellow); font-weight: 700; font-family: var(--font-mono); }
        .co2-high { color: var(--accent-orange); font-weight: 700; font-family: var(--font-mono); }

        .energy-takeaways {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }

        .takeaway-item {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        .takeaway-item h4 {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 0.3em;
        }

        .takeaway-item p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE 9: KEY TAKEAWAYS
           ========================================== */
        .takeaways-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-top: calc(var(--slide-padding) + 2.5rem);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .takeaways-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .key-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.875rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.35rem, 1vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .key-card-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 0.9vw, 0.75rem);
            color: var(--accent);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
        }

        .key-card h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 1.8vw, 1.25rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.25;
        }

        .key-card p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .key-card:nth-child(1) { border-top: 3px solid var(--accent-red); }
        .key-card:nth-child(2) { border-top: 3px solid var(--accent-orange); }
        .key-card:nth-child(3) { border-top: 3px solid var(--accent); }
        .key-card:nth-child(4) { border-top: 3px solid var(--accent-blue); }

        .closing-note {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            background: var(--accent-dim);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 201, 167, 0.25);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .closing-note strong { color: var(--accent); }

    </style>
</head>

    <!-- Progress bar -->

    <!-- ==========================================

    <section class="slide slide-title" id="slide-1" aria-label="Title slide">

    <!-- ==========================================

            <div class="milestone-context">
                <h2 class="reveal" style="font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--h2-size); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--text-primary);">
                    Atmospheric CO₂ Reaches 429 ppm
                </h2>
                <p class="reveal" style="font-size: var(--body-size); color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.5;">
                    50% Above Pre-Industrial Levels. Ground-based and satellite measurements confirm the sharp
                    acceleration, linked primarily to the burning of coal, oil, and natural gas.
                </p>

                <div class="ppm-bar-wrap reveal">

                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ==========================================
         SLIDE 3: GLOBAL EMISSIONS TRAJECTORY
         ========================================== -->
    <section class="slide" id="slide-3" aria-label="Global emissions trajectory">
        <div class="slide-header">
            <span class="slide-label">Historical Growth · 1750–2024</span>
            <span class="slide-num">03 / 09</span>
        </div>

        <div class="trajectory-layout">
            <div class="trajectory-header">
                <h2 class="section-heading reveal">Global Fossil Fuel CO₂ Emissions Grew Six-Fold</h2>
                <p class="reveal" style="font-size: var(--body-size); color: var(--text-secondary);">6 Billion to 35+ Billion Tonnes (1950–2024)</p>

    <script>
        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           Handles navigation, animations, progress
           ========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
                this.currentIndex = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;

                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupWheelNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupBarAnimations();
            }

            /* --- IntersectionObserver adds .visible for CSS animations --- */
            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            // Find slide index for progress tracking
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentIndex = idx;
                                this.updateProgress();
                                this.updateNavDots();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            /* --- Animate bar charts when slide becomes visible --- */
            setupBarAnimations() {
                // Standard bars use CSS custom property --w for width
                const applyBarWidths = (slide) => {
                    slide.querySelectorAll('.bar-fill[style*="--w"]').forEach(bar => {
                        const w = bar.style.getPropertyValue('--w') || bar.getAttribute('style').match(/--w:\s*([\d.%]+)/)?.[1];
                        if (w) bar.style.width = w;
                    });
                    // Per capita bars use --pw
                    slide.querySelectorAll('.pc-fill[style*="--pw"]').forEach(bar => {
                        const w = bar.style.getPropertyValue('--pw') || bar.getAttribute('style').match(/--pw:\s*([\d.%]+)/)?.[1];
                        if (w) bar.style.width = w;
                    });
                };

                // Observe slides for bar animation
                const barObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            setTimeout(() => applyBarWidths(entry.target), 200);
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.4 });

                this.slides.forEach(s => barObserver.observe(s));
            }

            /* --- Keyboard navigation: arrows, space, page keys --- */
            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch(e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex + 1);
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex - 1);
                            break;
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex + 1);
                            break;
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex - 1);
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.totalSlides - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            /* --- Mouse wheel: debounced to prevent multiple slides per scroll --- */
            setupWheelNav() {
                let wheelTimeout = null;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    if (this.isScrolling) return;
                    clearTimeout(wheelTimeout);
                    wheelTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                        if (e.deltaY > 0) {
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex + 1);
                        } else {
                            this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex - 1);
                        }
                    }, 50);
                }, { passive: false });
            }

            /* --- Touch / swipe support --- */
            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                let touchStartX = 0;

                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                    touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const dy = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    const dx = touchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
                    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) && Math.abs(dy) > 40) {
                        this.goToSlide(this.currentIndex + (dy > 0 ? 1 : -1));
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            /* --- Navigate to slide index with scroll-into-view --- */
            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= this.totalSlides || this.isScrolling) return;
                this.isScrolling = true;
                this.currentIndex = index;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                setTimeout(() => { this.isScrolling = false; }, 800);
                this.updateProgress();
                this.updateNavDots();
            }

            /* --- Progress bar across top of viewport --- */
            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgress();
            }

            updateProgress() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const pct = ((this.currentIndex) / (this.totalSlides - 1)) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = pct + '%';
            }

            /* --- Navigation dot indicators on right edge --- */
            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                if (!nav) return;
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    nav.appendChild(dot);
                });
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                document.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot').forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentIndex);
                });
            }
        }

        // Initialise on DOM ready
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();

            // Mark first slide visible immediately
            const firstSlide = document.querySelector('.slide');
            if (firstSlide) firstSlide.classList.add('visible');
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        .bar-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(10px, 1.8vh, 18px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            border-radius: 3px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 3px;
            width: 0;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .bar-fill { /* Widths applied via inline style */ }

        .bar-fill.china   { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f97316, #ef4444); }
        .bar-fill.usa     { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3b82f6, #6366f1); }
        .bar-fill.india   { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #eab308, #f97316); }
        .bar-fill.eu      { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-blue)); }
        .bar-fill.germany { background: rgba(139, 154, 184, 0.5); }
        .bar-fill.brazil  { background: rgba(139, 154, 184, 0.4); }
        .bar-fill.uk      { background: rgba(139, 154, 184, 0.35); }
        .bar-fill.france  { background: rgba(139, 154, 184, 0.3); }

        .bar-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            min-width: 4rem;
        }

        .emitters-right {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .figure-wrap {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            overflow: hidden;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .figure-wrap img {
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            max-height: min(40vh, 320px);
            object-fit: cover;
            display: block;
        }

        .figure-caption {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.55rem, 0.85vw, 0.72rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE 5: REGIONAL SHARE SHIFT
           ========================================== */
        .regional-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.25rem);
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-top: calc(var(--slide-padding) + 2.5rem);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .regional-body {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            align-items: center;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .era-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.875rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }

        .era-year {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .era-year.current { color: var(--accent); }

        /* Stacked area visual using CSS */
        .region-stack {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 3px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .region-band {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            padding: clamp(4px, 1vh, 8px) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            gap: 0.75rem;
        }

        .region-band-label {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
            min-width: 6rem;
        }

        .region-band-pct {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
            margin-left: auto;
        }

        .band-eu-us-1900 { background: #3b5998; }
        .band-asia-1900 { background: #1e3a5f; }
        .band-other-1900 { background: #0f2340; }

        .band-asia-2024 { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f97316, #ef4444); }
        .band-eu-us-2024 { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3b82f6, #6366f1); }
        .band-other-2024 { background: rgba(80, 100, 130, 0.8); }

        .shift-arrow {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }

        .shift-arrow-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            color: var(--accent);
            opacity: 0.7;
        }

        .shift-note {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: center;
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE 6: PER CAPITA 150× GAP
           ========================================== */
        .percapita-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-top: calc(var(--slide-padding) + 2.5rem);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
            align-items: start;
        }

        .percapita-chart {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .pc-bar-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 0.875rem);
        }

        .pc-country {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            min-width: clamp(3.5rem, 6vw, 6rem);
            text-align: right;
        }

        .pc-track {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(8px, 1.6vh, 16px);
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            border-radius: 3px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .pc-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 3px;
            width: 0;
            transition: width 1.1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .pc-fill { /* applied via inline style */ }

        .pc-fill.highest { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ef4444, #f97316); }
        .pc-fill.high    { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f97316, #eab308); }
        .pc-fill.medium  { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #eab308, #84cc16); }
        .pc-fill.average { background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.8); }
        .pc-fill.low     { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-blue)); }
        .pc-fill.lowest  { background: rgba(139, 154, 184, 0.4); }

        .pc-val {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            min-width: 3rem;
        }

        .percapita-right {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .figure-wrap-sm img {
            max-height: min(32vh, 220px);
        }

        .highlight-box {
            background: var(--accent-dim);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 201, 167, 0.3);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        .highlight-box p {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .highlight-box strong {
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE 7: 2024 ANNUAL CHANGE MAP
           ========================================== */
        .map-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.25rem);
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-top: calc(var(--slide-padding) + 2.5rem);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .map-body {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            overflow: hidden;
            align-items: start;
        }

        .map-figure {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .map-figure img {
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            max-height: min(52vh, 400px);
            object-fit: cover;
            display: block;
        }

        .map-analysis {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }

        .change-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            border-left: 3px solid transparent;
        }

        .change-card.declining { border-left-color: var(--accent); }
        .change-card.rising { border-left-color: var(--accent-orange); }
        .change-card.large-jump { border-left-color: var(--accent-red); }

        .change-card-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
        }

        .change-dot {
            width: clamp(8px, 1.2vw, 12px);
            height: clamp(8px, 1.2vw, 12px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .dot-blue  { background: var(--accent); }
        .dot-orange { background: var(--accent-orange); }
        .dot-red   { background: var(--accent-red); }

        .change-card-title {
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .change-card-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE 8: ENERGY MIX
           ========================================== */
        .energy-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1.25rem);
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-top: calc(var(--slide-padding) + 2.5rem);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .energy-body {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 3rem);
            overflow: hidden;
            align-items: start;
        }

        /* Comparison table */
        .compare-table {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .compare-table table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
        }

        .compare-table th {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1.2vw, 0.8rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 0.9vw, 0.75rem);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-align: left;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .compare-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1.2vw, 0.75rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .compare-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

        .compare-table .country-col {
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .co2-low  { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; font-family: var(--font-mono); }
        .co2-mid  { color: var(--accent-yellow); font-weight: 700; font-family: var(--font-mono); }
        .co2-high { color: var(--accent-orange); font-weight: 700; font-family: var(--font-mono); }

        .energy-takeaways {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
        }

        .takeaway-item {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        .takeaway-item h4 {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 0.3em;
        }

        .takeaway-item p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.45;
        }

        /* ==========================================
           SLIDE 9: KEY TAKEAWAYS
           ========================================== */
        .takeaways-layout {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            height: 100%;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
            padding-top: calc(var(--slide-padding) + 2.5rem);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .takeaways-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.75rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .key-card {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.875rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.35rem, 1vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .key-card-num {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 0.9vw, 0.75rem);
            color: var(--accent);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.12em;
        }

        .key-card h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.9rem, 1.8vw, 1.25rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.25;
        }

        .key-card p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .key-card:nth-child(1) { border-top: 3px solid var(--accent-red); }
        .key-card:nth-child(2) { border-top: 3px solid var(--accent-orange); }
        .key-card:nth-child(3) { border-top: 3px solid var(--accent); }
        .key-card:nth-child(4) { border-top: 3px solid var(--accent-blue); }

        .closing-note {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            background: var(--accent-dim);
            border: 1px solid rgba(0, 201, 167, 0.25);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        .closing-note strong { color: var(--accent); }

    </style>
</head>

            <div class="milestone-context">
                <h2 class="reveal" style="font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: var(--h2-size); font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--text-primary);">

                <p class="reveal" style="font-size: var(--body-size); color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.5;">

                    acceleration, linked primarily to the burning of coal, oil, and natural gas.

                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ==========================================
